title: Calendar alarms follow the calendar live + slide/tap to stop
note: PR open for Thursday's build; Curió merges after testing.
details: Calendar rules now follow the calendar: new matching events get alarms, moved events move them, deleted events drop them. Each rule picks Follow the calendar (default), Keep what I first saw, or Only events that exist now, with a (?) help sheet. Changes are noticed within seconds while the app is open (2-minute re-read for Google online), and on Android also with the app closed (calendar-change job + 15-minute backup). Ring screen: the amber arrow can be slid to press the button, and tapping the middle of the screen counts as Stop (tasks and wake-up check still apply). New text in 20 languages is machine-written and needs native review.
